name: Vegetarian Mushroom & Bell Pepper "Cheesesteak" Toasts with Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 green bell peppers
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Divide between the baking sheets.
Remove stems from portobello mushrooms; thinly slice. Add to the baking sheets with the peppers.
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place veggies in the oven and bake, stirring halfway through, until softened and starting to color in spots, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Change oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Sprinkle veggies with cheese. Working in batches, return baking sheets to the oven and broil until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.

Carefully remove cooked veggies from the baking sheets by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheets to a flat surface. (Stack foil layers one on top of the other if counter space is limited. Reserve baking sheets for the next step.)
Divide bread between the reserved baking sheets. Working in batches, place bread in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide dressed arugula and toast between plates; top the toast with cheesy mushrooms and peppers. Enjoy!
